title: Warning: iPhone users should upgrade promptly as leaked Coruna and DarkSword exploit kits spread
content_md:
Warning: iPhone users should upgrade promptly. The Coruna and DarkSword iPhone exploit kits previously disclosed by Google and iVerify have leaked and are now being widely used by criminal groups. They spread through malicious ads or compromised websites, and older iOS versions can be infected simply by opening a webpage, requiring no user action.

via Mastodon https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/11/11/iverify-iphone-exploit-kit-attacks-report/
exclude_reason: Secondary social summary of previously covered Coruna and DarkSword iPhone exploit-kit reporting.
